items.raw_excerpt: Nitin Gadkari, delayed by Mumbai traffic, advocates for replacing ageing flyovers with advanced technology to tackle congestion.
items.summary_en: Nitin Gadkari, India's Road Transport Minister, was stuck in Mumbai traffic for nearly an hour. He proposes replacing old flyovers with advanced technology to reduce congestion.

items.raw_excerpt: The high school leaving exams have been digital since 2016. Now, the rise of AI is raising new concerns about cheating.
items.summary_en: Finland's high school leaving exams have been digital since 2016. The rise of AI is now raising new concerns about cheating. This autumn, more students than ever signed up for the matriculation exams.

items.title_en: Record enrolment in autumn matriculation exams

items.summary_en: Young rocker Nene Royal from Phuket, Thailand is heading to the finale of America's Got Talent. She is confident in her final and most important performance on the popular show.

items.summary_en: Zarra is a tiny village in Valencia, Spain, with only about 450 people. The local council has started a campaign to bring in new neighbors and keep the town growing. This quiet corner of Spain hopes newcomers will help it stay lively.
items.summary_ko: 발렌시아 내륙의 작은 마을 자라는 주민 수가 450명에 불과하다. 자라 시는 새로운 이웃을 유입시켜 마을 성장을 이어가기 위한 캠페인을 시작했다. 스페인의 이 조용한 마을은 새로운 정착객이 마을에 활력을 불어넣어 주길 바라고 있다.

items.raw_excerpt: It was Rosie Putland's first week in Canberra in her new job, but the week was marred by what she calls discrimination. Ms Putland says she was refused a taxi and an Uber due to being in a wheelchair.
items.summary_en: It was Rosie Putland's first week in Canberra in her new job. She says she was refused a taxi and an Uber because she uses a wheelchair. She calls it discrimination.

items.raw_excerpt: Nitin Nabin offers prayers for prosperity and progress at BJP headquarters during Ganesh Chaturthi celebrations in New Delhi.
items.summary_en: Nitin Nabin prayed for prosperity at BJP headquarters in New Delhi during Ganesh Chaturthi. The Hindu festival honors the elephant-headed god and is celebrated across India each year.

items.raw_excerpt: An estimated 72,500 passengers were counted on trains across the Auckland Transport network by 5pm today - 25,000 more than last Monday.
items.summary_en: Auckland's City Rail Link had 25,000 more train passengers on its first weekday compared to last Monday. The total number of passengers reached 72,500 by 5pm. This shows strong public interest in the new rail service.
items.summary_ko: 오클랜드 시티 레일 링크의 첫 평일에 지난 월요일보다 2만5천 명이 더 많은 승객이 전철을 이용했습니다. 오후 5시까지 총 7만2천5백 명이 전철을 탔습니다. 이는 새 철도 서비스에 대한 시민들의 높은 관심을 보여줍니다.
items.title_en: Auckland's New Train Line Sees 25,000 Extra Riders on First Weekday

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwan's Chen Zhi-ray (陳子睿) and Lin Yu-chieh (林煜傑) won the men's doubles final at the Yonex-Sunrise Vietnam Open badminton tournament on Sunday, quickly dispatching their Singaporean opponents in back-to-back games in 27 minutes.
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Chen Zhi-ray and Lin Yu-chieh won the men's doubles final at the Yonex-Sunrise Vietnam Open badminton tournament. They beat their Singaporean opponents in back-to-back games in just 27 minutes.
items.summary_ko: 대만의 천즈뤠이와 린위제가 베트남 오픈 배드민턴 대회 남자 복식 결승에서 우승했습니다. 싱가포르 선수들을 27분 만에 연속 두 경기로 이겼습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Sunshine Coast's Australian Off Road campers ceased operating late last week, with customers saying they have been unable to make contact with the company.
items.summary_en: An Australian Off Road camper van manufacturer on the Sunshine Coast stopped operating last week. Customers say they cannot reach the company and were not given any notice about the closure.
items.summary_ko: 선샤인코스트에 위치한 Australian Off Road 캠퍼밴 제조사가 지난주 갑자기 운영을 중단했다. 고객들은 회사에 연락이 닿지 않으며, 폐업 사전 통보를 받지 못했다고 밝혔다.

items.raw_excerpt: South Korean label, BigHit Music, announced on Monday (Sep 14) that it will hold auditions seeking new male trainees in Singapore on Oct 24, 2026.
items.summary_en: BigHit Music announced it will hold auditions seeking new male trainees in Singapore on October 24, 2026. The South Korean label is the agency behind global pop group BTS.

items.raw_excerpt: Almost 90 new homes will be built on Yorkshire farmland after councillors granted planning permission.
items.summary_en: Councillors granted planning permission for almost 90 new homes on farmland near the Yorkshire coastal village of Brotton. The development will be built on agricultural land in the area.

items.raw_excerpt: Katie Craig's son was among the last to be born before the local birthing unit shut down. But after years on bypass, the service has returned.
items.summary_en: A birthing unit in regional Queensland has reopened after being closed for years. Local mother Katie Craig's son was among the last babies born there before the shutdown. Community advocacy has finally brought the service back to the area.
items.summary_ko: 지역 사회의 지속적인 노력 끝에 퀸즈랜드 지역 분만 시설이 다시 문을 열었다. 케이티 크레이그의 아들은 시설 폐쇄 전 마지막으로 태어난 아기 중 한 명이었다. 주민들의 운동으로 그 지역에 다시 분만 서비스가 제공되게 되었다.
items.title_en: Birthing Care Returns to Regional Queensland After Community Campaign
items.title_ko: 커뮤니티 운동으로 퀸즈랜드 지역에 분만 서비스 복귀

items.raw_excerpt: Affected workers will receive job-matching assistance, as well as guidance and advice on workplace matters, the Singapore Manual & Mercantile Workers' Union said.
items.summary_en: A union in Singapore will hold a job-matching session for workers who lost their jobs after True Fitness and True Yoga closed. Affected employees will get help finding new jobs and advice on workplace matters.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르의 한 노조가 True Fitness와 True Yoga 폐업으로 실직한 근로자들을 위한 일자리 알선 세션을 열 예정입니다. 피해를 입은 직원들은 새로운 일자리를 찾는 지원과 직장 관련 상담을 받을 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Singapore union to hold job fair for laid-off gym workers

items.title_original: NTUC-affiliated union to hold job-matching session for former True Fitness, True Yoga employees

items.raw_excerpt: A West Bengal committee is reviewing proposals to rename roads in Kolkata, including those named after communist leaders.
items.summary_en: A committee in West Bengal, India, is reviewing proposals to rename several roads in Kolkata. Some of the roads are currently named after communist leaders. The panel is examining each proposal as part of a wider road renaming effort.
items.summary_ko: 인도 서벵갈주의 위원회가 콜카타 내 도로명 변경안을 검토 중입니다. 현재 도로 중 일부는 공산주의 지도자들의 이름이 붙어 있습니다. 위원회는 광범위한 도로명 개정 과정의 일환으로 각안을 살펴보고 있습니다.
items.title_en: West Bengal panel reviews road renaming proposals
items.title_ko: 서벵갈, 도로명 변경 검토 중 — 공산주의 지도자 이름 포함
items.title_original: Bengal panel examining proposals to rename roads

items.raw_excerpt: Applying for citizenship in Austria can be a lengthy and daunting process - and understanding the lingo is like learning a new language in itself. These are the top words and phrases you're likely to hear along the way.
items.summary_en: Applying for citizenship in Austria takes a long time and can feel overwhelming. This guide explains the key words and phrases you will hear during the process. Learning these terms helps you understand each step more clearly.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아에서 시민권을 신청하려면 오랜 시간이 걸리고 복잡할 수 있습니다. 이 기사에서는 신청 과정에서 자주 듣게 되는 주요 단어와 표현을 정리해 줍니다. 이러한 용어를 미리 익혀두면 각 단계를 더 쉽게 이해할 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Words and phrases you need for Austrian citizenship
items.title_ko: 오스트리아 시민권 신청에 필요한 핵심 용어 정리
items.title_original: The vocabulary you need to understand the Austrian citizenship process

items.raw_excerpt: Meta restricts access to a viral AI video of Keralam CM V.D. Satheesan dancing with KSEB staff amid power cuts.
items.summary_en: Meta has restricted access to a viral AI-generated video of Kerala Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan dancing with KSEB staff. The video was created using artificial intelligence during ongoing power cuts in the state. Meta moved to limit the video's spread as it falsely depicted the Chief Minister.
items.summary_ko: 메타가 케랄라 주지사 V.D. Satheesan이 KSEB 직원들과 함께 춤추는 AI 생성 영상의 접근을 제한했습니다. 이 영상은 주의 전력 부족 상황에서 인공지능으로 만들어졌으며, 주지사를 왜곡하는 내용이었습니다. 메타는 영상의 확산을 막기 위해 조치를 취했습니다.
items.title_en: Meta restricts viral AI video of Kerala CM dancing with staff
items.title_ko: 케랄라 주지사 직원들과 춤추는 AI 영상 접근 제한
items.title_original: Meta restricts access to viral AI video of Keralam CM dancing over power cuts

items.raw_excerpt: There is news about the Portuguese economy that deserves much more attention. Ten Portuguese startups were selected to represent Portugal at SF Tech Week 2026 in San Francisco, in what will be the first Portuguese participation integrated into the official agenda of one of the major meetings of the international technological ecosystem.
items.summary_en: Ten Portuguese startups have been chosen to represent Portugal at SF Tech Week 2026 in San Francisco. This marks the first time Portuguese companies will be part of the official agenda at this major international tech event.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈의 10개 스타트업이 샌프란시스코에서 열리는 SF 테크 위크 2026에서 포르투갈을 대표하게 됐다. 이번이 국제 기술 분야의 주요 행사 공식 일정에 포르투갈 기업이 참여하는 것은 처음이다.
items.title_en: Portuguese Startups to Represent Portugal at San Francisco Tech Week
items.title_ko: 포르투갈 스타트업들 실리콘밸리에서 열리는 테크 위크에 참가

items.raw_excerpt: Women say pension delays are causing further financial stress after losing their husbands.
items.summary_en: Widows in England are struggling with long delays in receiving pension payments from Capita. The delays are causing significant financial stress for women who have already lost their husbands. Many women say they have been left in tears by the lengthy waiting times.
items.summary_ko: 영국의 과부들이 카피타 회사의 연금 지급 지연으로 큰 어려움을 겪고 있다. 지연은 이미 남편을 잃은 여성들에게 심각한 재정적 스트레스를 주고 있다. 많은 여성들이 긴 대기 시간 때문에 눈물을 흘리고 있다고 호소한다.
items.title_en: Capita Pension Delays Leave Widows Distressed
items.title_ko: 카피타 연금 지연으로 과부들 고통 호소
items.title_original: Capita pension backlog leaves widows 'in tears'

items.raw_excerpt: Official at the Master of the Durban High Court says drafting a Will is not only for the wealthy.
items.summary_en: An official at the Master of the Durban High Court says drafting a Will is not only for the wealthy. Everyone should write a Will, not only rich people. A Will helps protect your family and your property.
